snippet.title: Mega Drive Longplay [528] 3 Ninjas Kick Back
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Amy Rose

A longplay of 3 Ninjas Kick Back is a beat 'em up video game for the Super NES, Sega Genesis/Mega Drive and Sega CD platforms. It was developed by Malibu Interactive, published by Sony Imagesoft and was released in 1994. -
